showUnit.description: Whether to show unit in labels, default: false

sunburst.description: Enable sunburst mode: clicking a segment expands or collapses its children as an outer ring, default: false

outerLabelUnit.description: Unit string to append to outer labels, default: "%"

outerLabelMaxLength.description: Maximum character length for labels before trim (0 = no limit), default: 0 Available when showOuterLabels==true.

outerLabelDecimalPlaces.description: Number of decimal places in labels, default: 0

legend.description: Whether to display the legend below the chart, default: false

fixedHeight.description: Fixed height of the chart in pixels (determines chart circumference), default: 320. The chart's circumference is always based on this fixed height to match other radial instruments.

data.description: The segments, one object each: `label`, `value` and, for the sunburst, `children` (objects with `label` and `value`).

colors.description: Colours of the series or segments in order, as CSS colour strings. Empty uses the palette of the scheme.

componentSize.description: Component size: regular, medium, large or xl.
